This project combines collision, traffic, road-network, and contextual datasets
to estimate road risk relative to exposure. Each source has a distinct role:
some define the road network, some provide observed outcomes, and others
provide traffic or contextual predictors used by the
[Open Road Risk modelling approach](../methodology/modelling.qmd).

## How the sources fit together

| Source | Main role | Used for | Key limitation |
|---|---|---|---|
| [STATS19 collision data](stats19.qmd) | Collision outcome data | Observed injury collisions used as the response variable in the collision model | Police-reported injury collisions only; excludes damage-only incidents |
| [OS Open Roads network data](openroads.qmd) | Road network geometry | Base road-link network for snapping, feature generation, and scoring | Simplified representation of real-world road layout |
| [AADF traffic counts](aadf.qmd) | Observed traffic counts | Training data for estimating annual average daily traffic where direct counts are unavailable | Sparse coverage, especially away from major roads |
| [WebTRIS sensor data](webtris.qmd) | Traffic timing and vehicle mix | Time-of-day profiles, traffic composition, and support for exposure features | Biased toward National Highways / major-road sensors |
| OpenStreetMap | Supplementary road attributes | Additional tags such as bridge/tunnel or road context where useful | Uneven coverage and tagging consistency |
| OS Terrain 50 | Terrain context | Link-level grade features derived from the 50 m elevation grid | Bare-earth grid; local structures and fine gradients are smoothed |
| ONS LSOA population estimates | Area context | Population-density features around road links | Area-level proxy, not direct road use |
| ONS 2021 Rural-Urban Classification | Area context | Urban/rural context joined at LSOA level | LSOA-level classification, not road-specific land use |
| English Indices of Deprivation 2025 | Deprivation context | IMD and domain deciles joined at LSOA level | England-only small-area index; contextual, not causal |

## Source roles in the model

### Outcome source
- **[STATS19 collision data](stats19.qmd)** provides the observed collision outcome.

### Network source
- **[OS Open Roads network data](openroads.qmd)** defines the scored road-link network.

### Exposure sources
- **[AADF traffic counts](aadf.qmd)** provide direct traffic-count training examples.
- **[WebTRIS sensor data](webtris.qmd)** provides time-profile and vehicle-mix information.

### Context sources
- **OSM**, **OS Terrain 50**, **ONS population estimates**, **ONS Rural-Urban Classification**, and **English Indices of Deprivation 2025** provide supporting road and local-context features.
